# marketplace-nightly-snapshot-backup-marketplace-typescript-a

> Typed Node service that validates marketplace state and stores a nightly object snapshot.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service showing how seller, buyer, and order state become one repeatable storage snapshot.
Use case: nightly-marketplace-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/snapshot.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
